turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero from his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so tell me who decided that and on what basis.
You're welcome. Now answer my question: who entered the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Crazy weather today, eh? Did you see the Flames game?
We're not here about the hockey, Hale. Twenty minutes, and you've used two of them on the weather.
What do you do for fun?
I read school procedures, Hale. Section 4.2 says the parent is called before any mark goes in, so either you start talking about Owen's essay or I'm going upstairs to the principal now.
